bundle.shortDescription: Ad-free, lightweight YouTube client for Windows with 144p–8K downloads
bundle.longDescription: WinTube is an open-source, ad-free, lightweight YouTube client for Windows with selectable-quality downloads from 144p to 8K. Built with Rust and Tauri 2. Watch without ads, download MP4 with H.264/AAC remux (no ffmpeg required for most downloads), and play offline.
